_meta.description: Repairable review criteria, keyed by criterion id (#3544). Replaces the hardcoded AUTO_FIXABLE_CRITERIA list in review-format.js. Read by .claude/scripts/shared/lib/review-repair.js for both /review-issue (pre-finalize repairs) and /resolve-review (Pass 1 auto-fix).
_meta.preFinalize: true: /review-issue writes the repair into the body before Step 3 finalize, without a prompt, when the finding carries a concrete fix. false: /resolve-review Pass 2 asks for it, after finalize, carrying the entry as the finding's repair { kind, description } to shape the Accept suggestion preview — the fix needs content only the user can approve (repro steps, a proposed solution) (#3548).
_meta.types: Issue types the entry applies to.
_meta.modes: Review modes the entry applies to (review-mode-criteria.json modes).
_meta.env: dev: applies only in the framework dev repo, matching the criterion's own env (CommandsSrc/ present). Absent: everywhere.

deployment-impact-assessed.description: Write **Deployment Impact:** dev-only | deployed (areas), derived from **Files to modify:** against framework-manifest.json deploymentFiles (review-repair.js deriveDeploymentImpact). No repair when any path cannot be classified.

depends-on-valid.description: Write the **Depends on:** line the review stated exactly, e.g. **Depends on:** #12, #14.

priority-set.description: Set the board priority the review named: gh pmu move <N> --priority <p0|p1|p2>.

test-coverage-bug.description: Append the test-only acceptance criterion the review wrote, and add its test files to **Files to modify:** (#3588). Guarded by review-repair.js classifyRepair: every path the AC names or adds must be a test path under test-coverage-conventions.json that a declared suite runs; otherwise not repairable, and the finding goes to /resolve-review Pass 2.

test-coverage-story.description: Append the test-only acceptance criterion the review wrote, and add its test files to **Files to modify:** (#3588). Guarded by review-repair.js classifyRepair: every path the AC names or adds must be a test path under test-coverage-conventions.json that a declared suite runs; otherwise not repairable, and the finding goes to /resolve-review Pass 2.

test-coverage-enhancement.description: Append the test-only acceptance criterion the review wrote, and add its test files to **Files to modify:** (#3588). Guarded by review-repair.js classifyRepair: every path the AC names or adds must be a test path under test-coverage-conventions.json that a declared suite runs; otherwise not repairable, and the finding goes to /resolve-review Pass 2.

ac-present.description: Add an acceptance-criteria skeleton; /resolve-review Step 1b applies.

ac-present-testable.description: Add or sharpen acceptance criteria; /resolve-review Step 1b applies.

expected-actual.description: Add expected vs actual behavior; /resolve-review previews it.

proposed-fix-described.description: Describe the proposed fix; /resolve-review previews it.

proposed-solution.description: Describe the proposed solution; /resolve-review previews it.
